newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-News Corp says no Internet profits yet.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-News Corp says no Internet profits yet.

text.p: News Ltd managing director Lachlan Murdoch said on Wednesday News Corp was yet to see profits from its Internet businesses and admitted the immediate future of the Internet was unclear.
"Nobody knows where it's going. Very few are making any money from it. I know we're certainly not," Murdoch told delegates at a film and television producer's conference.
But he noted there was an international consensus that the Internet lay at the heart of the next generation of media products.
News Corp's latest Internet play occurred in September when its Kesmai unit formed a new company to publish and distribute computer games and online services via the Internet.
This followed News Corp's decision in May to sell an online service, Delphi Internet Services, back to its former owner and chief executive, Dan Bruns.
News Corp, which purchased the company in 1993, and MCI Communications Corp planned to dilute their 50-50 ownership of Delphi with new partners, MCI had said in January.
MCI later became News Corp's partner in Delphi.

Recently, MCI's relationship with News Corp has become more distant with the announcement earlier this month of a US$20 billion merger between MCI and British Telecommunications plc and the sell down of MCI's stake in a U.S. satellite joint venture with News Corp.

News Corp originally formed an alliance with MCI in 1995 to combine its publishing and television expertise with MCI's communications network and marketing skill, particularly in the emerging market of the Internet.
News Ltd is the Australian arm of News Corp.
